# Balvant Chavda (0x0doteth)

> Balvant Chavda, known online as 0x0doteth, is an independent cybersecurity researcher from India. He specializes in vulnerability discovery, bug bounty hunting, and responsible disclosure across web applications, mobile platforms, smart contracts, and cloud services.
